title: Share {{name}}
intro: Add it to Floorbit's own list, which every Floorbit fetches, or give it to another event as a file.
sourceHelp: A link (the publisher's support page) or a note ("seen in our LAN cache log"). The review needs it.
onlyMatches: Only what it matches: no seats, no numbers, nothing about the event.
tried: Here it was seen by {{seats}} seats in the last 24 hours.
triedNone: Nothing matched it here in the last 24 hours (or fewer than 5 seats). Check the domains before you share it.
tooLong: Too much for GitHub to fill in. Download the file and add it to games/ by hand.
review: GitHub opens with the file filled in; your account opens the pull request. Once it is reviewed and merged, every Floorbit gets it with Floorbit's list.
exportHelp: The event's own applications and what it added to built-in ones, as a rules file
triedLookups: Here it was seen by {{seats}} seats in the last 24 hours, in {{lookups}} DNS lookups.
